answer_1.quote: Dialogue models often struggle to produce engaging utterances in conversations, tending to generate responses which are common in the training data...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate three diversity metrics: two semantic diversity metrics, Baseline NLI Diversity (Section 3) and Sent-BERT, and one lexical diversity metric, distinct-n.

answer_3.quote: We propose a new metric aimed at measuring semantic diversity by leveraging a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model to score a set of multiple dialogue model responses for a single conversation...

answer_4.quote: Each set of responses in conTest and decTest is scored by 10 annotators from 1 (not diverse at all) to 5 (very diverse) with half-point increments.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate diversity on a Likert scale
